scope_tr: 4000 tonluk soguk hava deposu aynı anda hem donuk hem de taze ürün saklayabilecek şekilde tasarlanmış ve 2016 dan beri faaliyete geçmiştir. Tesiste günde 100 ton meyve tasnif ve paketleme yapabilen tam otomatik bir sistem kurulmuştur.
scope_en: The 4000-ton cold air store is designed to store both frozen and fresh products at the same time and has been in operation since 2016. A fully automated system capable of sorting and packing 100 tons of fruit per day was established.
